note-01.claim: the gap between cheapest and priciest per solved task

raw.description: Per-token pricing does not predict what a coding task actually costs. Measured across six current models, the gap widens from 38x to 146x.

note-02.claim: cost spread across four harnesses at one pass rate

raw.description: Hold GPT-5.6 Sol and the task set constant, change only the coding harness, and the point-estimate cost per solved task moves from $0.36 to $1.37—a 3.77x spread.

note-03.claim: more tasks to ship a data/ML pipeline than a mobile app

raw.description: Solvency's calculator asks "how many tasks?" Measured across 60 shipped GitHub repos in six use cases, a solo mobile app ships in dozens of tasks (median 48); a data/ML pipeline needs hundreds (median 479).
